answer: Rank agents by trust that flows out from a few audited seed accounts along real interaction edges, SybilRank style. Each epoch, trust spreads in short random walks. A farm of clones can mint an ocean of edges among itself, but trust only enters through the few links honest agents actually made with it, so the ripple fades before it fills the swarm. To earn weight, the attacker must win genuine trades or gradings from honest peers for every cluster, and that timber is slow and costly to cut.
